During the right cycle he then waits for price to take the previous cycle's extreme and turn, and wants to see SMT on a small move. Klasická quarterly theory dělí den na čt: Classic quarterly theory divides the day into four six-hour parts: Asia 18:00–0:00, London 0:00–6:00, New York 6:00–12:00 and the afternoon 12:00–18:00, each further into four ninety-minute quarters. According to the interview summary Zeussy uses a different grid: London 2:30–7:00 and the New York morning 7:00–11:30, each with three ninety-minute cycles (accumulation, manipulation, distribution). So the cycle borders differ between the two approaches by half an hour to an hour and a half. Whoever mixes an indicator of one grid with the rules of the other reads different cycles than they think. No test shows that one grid works better than the other.
Vyber si jednu mřížku a drž ji všude: v: Choose one grid and keep it everywhere: in the indicator, in the journal and in the statistics. For Zeussy the New York morning ends at 11:30, not at 12:00.

Sequential SMT, zkráceně SSMT, je SMT di: Sequential SMT, SSMT for short, is an SMT divergence that doesn't form at one moment but between two consecutive ninety-minute cycles. Example: NQ in the second cycle makes a new high above the first cycle's high, ES doesn't. According to the strategy description such a divergence between the first and second cycle should hint at what the third will do. It is traded on the five-minute chart, in New York on ES and NQ. The term comes from the trader Daye's quarterly theory, which Zeussy's work with cycles also builds on. The page gives no independent test.
Hranice cyklu je místo, kde má smysl por: The cycle border is the place where it makes sense to compare the highs and lows of NQ and ES. Take a divergence as confirmation, not as a standalone signal.
